# controld_devices (Data Source)

Lists all ControlD devices in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_devices" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The list of devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `ddns_status` (Boolean) Whether ControlD-managed Dynamic DNS is enabled for this device.
- `ddns_subdomain` (String) The subdomain used for ControlD-managed Dynamic DNS.
- `desc` (String) The description of the device.
- `device_id` (String) The unique device identifier used to build its DNS resolver endpoints.
- `icon` (String) The device icon.
- `id` (String) The device identifier (PK).
- `learn_ip` (Boolean) Whether the device should learn and remember the IPs it connects from.
- `legacy_ipv4_status` (Boolean) Whether legacy IPv4 resolving is enabled for this device.
- `name` (String) The name of the device.
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile applied to this device.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether the device is restricted to learned IPs only.
- `stats` (Number) The analytics level for the device.
- `status` (Number) The device status.
